findings.headline: Move owner-dependent work out of this ref callback.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 runs ref callbacks unowned, so getOwner() is null inside them and the onCleanup call(s) here no longer register with the component (Solid 1.x ran the callback inside the component's owner).
findings.guidance: Keep only element capture in the ref callback. Move one-off setup and its cleanup into onSettled in the component body, returning the cleanup function, or into the owned setup half of a directive factory whose returned apply callback receives the element.
